programs.showName: Moti Na Chowkre Sapna Man Ditha
programs.description: A woman works hard to support her family and longs to find someone she can be with. However, things worsen when she falls in love with a man only to learn he loves her sister.
A small misunderstanding turns into a bigger conflict between Sagar and Dhwani. Emotions take over, and what seemed simple now feels complicated.
